release_notes:
v1.0.9+9 - Eradication of Redundant Time Tiers & Dedicated Digital Guest Pass Architecture
- Eliminated redundant 'Time Pass Streaming Tiers' sub-tab and stats card from Guest Hub, streamlining public offerings to Song Tutorials, Digital PDFs, and Live Guest Admissions Roster
- Removed obsolete Sidebar Item 10 ('Time-Rated Passes'): Physical studios are strictly reserved for enrolled students in full courses with faculty; walk-in studio passes permanently decommissioned
- Granular 1-Hr, 2-Hr, and Full Lifetime Unlock: Song tutorials and bite-sized guest masterclasses now directly and exclusively define their own micro-tuition rates
- Unified Student Checkout: Public catalog pass duration modal now dynamically loads each tutorial's exact 1-hour, 2-hour, and full unlock pricing
